originalTitle: How Compass Earnings Blew Past Estimates in a Lousy Housing Market
summary: Compass stock was rising in after-hours trading after the company reported earnings and issued guidance that exceeded consensus estimates. Compass’s ongoing integration of the Anywhere brokerage business and partnership with Redfin helped. Compass reported basic earnings of twelve cents a share, or eleven cents a share diluted, on $4.3 billion in revenue in its second quarter, the real estate brokerage said in a Tuesday announcement.

chineseTitle: 康帕斯收益如何在糟糕的房地产市场中超出预期
chineseSummary: 在该公司公布收益并发布超出市场普遍预期的指引后，该公司股价在盘后交易中上涨。 Compass 对 Anywhere 经纪业务的持续整合以及与 Redfin 的合作起到了帮助作用。房地产经纪公司 Compass 在周二的公告中表示，第二季度营收为 43 亿美元，每股基本收益为 12 美分，稀释后每股收益为 11 美分。
